decisions.reason: Confirmed logic defect: with the same nonzero k underlying every V_S, the old Sigma intersect V_S tests membership at every rank and makes {1} generate the zero-transition module. Supported pairs (S,v), their specified-support containment, and the matching skeletal set restore the image-span formula; a finite maximum of the recorded support sizes now proves bounded generation. Empty generators span zero, and intersections and finite sums use no AC.

The local padding formula produced (0) at lambda=empty and n=0, while partitions have positive parts and the actual padding supplier explicitly uses empty[0]=empty. Added that convention and the rank-zero trivial Specht module. Deleting the first row gives a unique tail in every rank; constituents remain simple subquotients, and their inverse images under quotient maps prove weight monotonicity without any infinite decomposition or AC.

Part (ii) admitted negative integers k, making S_k and its coinvariants undefined (for example n=0, k=-1). Restricted that part and its Given data to 0<=k<=n. Verified the proof: finite linear systems preserve Hom dimensions under Q-to-C and Q-to-F scalar extension, split Specht endomorphism rings are F, Pieri fixes induction multiplicities, and averaging plus adjunction yields the removal rule, including empty strips and S_0.

Step 3.1 used V(rho)_n for a full partition rho of n, outside the padding domain when n>0. Replaced all three occurrences by V(eta)_n=V_rho with rho=eta[n]. Restricted F1 to nonnegative strip length and F2 to admissible padded labels and finite groups. Verified parts (i)–(iii) by bottom-box removals and interlacing; a finite orbit span in any nonzero subquotient contains a simple module of tail size <=a, whose nonzero coinvariants inject by finite averaging. The Statement is unchanged.

F6 restated a horizontal-strip decomposition that its cited supplier does not state. This is nonfatal: no proof step needs that decomposition, because F4 supplies weight(M(lambda))=|lambda| directly. Removed the unused clause and corrected the Statement source pointer for bounded generation. Verified the naturality-square quotient bound, finite evaluation-sum surjectivity bound, and reduction of every simple subquotient to finite orbit spans and finite-dimensional coefficient submodules; these prove weight<=d even with infinite-dimensional values, without AC.
